note: Triennial election of the 19 electoral divisions of Dungannon rural district, one member each, polled on 5 June 1952. Twelve Unionists and five Nationalists were returned unopposed; Crossdernott and Coalisland were contested. The only new members named were at Clonaneese, Bush and Newmills (Belfast News-Letter, 21 May 1952, p. 4). At the new council's first meeting Moses Busby was elected chairman for the 19th successive year; the report names Minterburn as the division 'which he continues to represent' (Belfast Telegraph, 12 June 1952, p. 5). Returned unopposed.
